scenarios.title: Clean file: straight through to go-live and export

checks.criterion: A clean file is validated as Ready with no findings
Every readiness check passes before approval
An analyst cannot approve go-live
The export loads every record exactly once
The evidence package's SHA-256 manifest matches every file
The client shows as Live after the export

scenarios.title: Poor-quality file: 2,000 rows with 52 planted errors

checks.criterion: The file is Not ready, with the planted blockers and warnings counted
Every planted error is found at the right line, with no false alarms
One exception is opened per rule group, each with severity and status
Go-live cannot be approved while blockers remain
A blocker cannot be accepted or waived
A warning can be accepted by an approver with a note, and the change is recorded
Nobody can mark an exception resolved by hand
The client sees the issue letter only once sent, written with their own column names
checks.actual: 0 before, 1 after sending; client column names used: True

checks.criterion: A rule-based explanation is always available, even when AI is unavailable
checks.actual: 6 rows in the column 'Rendering NPI' (platform field provider_npi) break the rule 'exactly

scenarios.title: Different schema with ambiguous mappings and a rule change

checks.criterion: Ambiguous, low-confidence and missing suggestions are flagged, not hidden
A mapping with unconfirmed ambiguous or missing fields cannot be submitted
The analyst's correction of the suggested NPI column is logged
The analyst who prepared a mapping cannot approve it
With the baseline rules, the vendor's MM/DD/YYYY dates are blockers
The rule change is a new approved version, and it invalidates the earlier validation
Re-validated under the approved rules, the file is Ready
The configuration change is traceable: who drafted, what changed, who approved
A saved template is reused for the same layout with high confidence

scenarios.title: Multiple resubmissions: fixed, unresolved, new and regressed problems

checks.criterion: Resubmission 2 is compared with 1: fixed, new and still-unresolved problems
checks.actual: {'fixed': ['claim_status: one of paid / denied / pending / adjusted', 'provider_npi: exactly 10 digits'], 'new': ['member_dob: not in the future', 'service_date: not before member_dob'], 'unresolved': ['paid_amount: not greater than billed_amount', 'place_of_service: exactly 2 digits']}

checks.criterion: Exceptions absent from the resubmission are resolved automatically
checks.actual: NPI resolved: Not found in submission #2 (run 6).

checks.criterion: A problem that comes back is reopened, with its history kept
Ready only after a file with no blockers, with every exception resolved
The scorecard reports rounds to acceptance and rework from the records

scenarios.title: Operational failure: duplicates, failed and interrupted runs, bad files, downstream outage

checks.criterion: Uploading the same file twice stores it once
When AI is unavailable, mapping falls back to name matching and says so
checks.actual: Gemini is not configured on this server (set GEMINI_API_KEY and GEMINI_MODEL). N

checks.criterion: A failed run is recorded and a retry completes with the full result
A run interrupted mid-processing is marked interrupted on recovery and retried without loss
A file cut off mid-row is caught as a blocker on the broken row
A file that cannot be read to the end is never ready, and nothing is cleared by the partial scan
Re-sending the good file recovers: Ready, and the file-level problems resolve
A downstream outage fails the export cleanly, keeping the batches already delivered
checks.actual: failed after 1 of 3 batches: Batch 2 of 3 failed after 3 attempts: The downstream system did not re

checks.criterion: The resumed export, with a lost acknowledgement, loads every claim exactly once
Asking to export again returns the same export and loads nothing twice

scenarios.title: Security boundaries: client separation, roles, sessions and audit

checks.criterion: A client contact sees only their own client
Another client's records look exactly like records that do not exist (404)
An analyst without access to a client cannot read or upload to it
A client contact cannot approve, change status, or read audit and evidence, but can add notes
checks.actual: {'approve go-live': 403, 'change exception status': 403, 'read audit': 403, 'download evidence': 403, 'read mappings': 403, 'add note': 200}

checks.criterion: Requests without a valid session are refused (401)
Five wrong passwords lock the account, even against the right password, until unlocked
Nobody approves their own change, not even an administrator (four-eyes)
Signing out ends the session
Weak passwords are refused
The hash-chained audit trail verifies end to end

portfolio_kpis.name: First-pass acceptance rate
portfolio_kpis.definition: Clients whose first validated file was Ready ÷ clients with a validated file.

portfolio_kpis.name: Mean rounds to acceptance
portfolio_kpis.definition: Submissions up to and including the first Ready file, for clients that reached Ready.

portfolio_kpis.name: Rework rate
portfolio_kpis.definition: Validated submissions that were Not ready ÷ all validated submissions.

portfolio_kpis.name: Median hours to resolve an exception
portfolio_kpis.definition: From the run that opened an exception group to the run that no longer contained it.

portfolio_kpis.name: Validation runs completed on first attempt
portfolio_kpis.definition: Completed runs with one attempt ÷ runs that finished (completed or failed).
